model_equations.state: R_i(t): firing-rate state of neuron i
source_notes: The RHS receives noise_stdv but the random input-noise term is commented out; noiseStdv has no effect on this RHS in the inspected implementation.
The separate weight-noise path perturbs W before the RHS; do not conflate that with input noise.
The connectivity matrix is transposed before sign-based excitatory/inhibitory reweighting.

network_artifacts.cryptographic_digests: unavailable; must be obtained from materialized files before reproduction

default_simulation.save_grid: jnp.arange(0, T + dt/2, dt), sorted, clipped to [0,T], unique

default_neuron_parameters.distribution: truncated normal; sample_trunc_normal default lower bound 0
default_neuron_parameters.size_scaling: a divided by normalized size; threshold multiplied by normalized size; normalization uses median size

solver_output_handling.postprocess_non_finite_values: replace NaN and Inf with zero
solver_output_handling.reproduction_gate: preserve and audit raw solution.ys, Diffrax result/status, accepted/rejected steps, and transformations before any replacement or clipping
solver_output_handling.claim_rule: a sanitized or clipped trajectory cannot be reported as an unmodified solver result without an explicit transformation receipt

data_artifact_reconciliation.rule: Do not assume these records are equivalent. Materialize both manifests, compare files/checksums/roles, and pin the correct record per artifact.

reproduction_gates: pin source commit and all source/config blob SHAs
resolve Zenodo artifact-role discrepancy and record per-file checksums
verify matrix row/column identity against the neuron annotation table
verify neuron parameter sample seeds and array shape
capture raw Diffrax termination/status and full save-grid completion
reject or separately record NaN/Inf replacement and clipping
reproduce DNg100 baseline before any circuit pruning
compare output distributions, not just a single aggregate score
